title: Fabric_4L Authoritative Evidence Record
description: Schema for a single authoritative evidence record produced by an execution lane and consumed by the release evaluator. BLOCKING SEMANTICS: any conclusion other than 'pass' blocks the decision at the control's registered decision point. A record that fails this schema MUST be treated as missing evidence, which also blocks. Evidence MUST be immutable and retained according to policy; a later commit invalidates SHA-bound evidence; rebuilding an artifact invalidates digest-bound certification.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier of this evidence record.

control_id.description: The control this evidence proves: a register control (CTRL-<gate>-<nn>) or a security audit control/check (FAB4L-SEC-P{n}-{DOMAIN}[-NNN]). The evaluator rejects evidence for unregistered controls.

kind.description: Evidence kind, aligned with the Enterprise Security Audit Contract evidenceKind enum.

source_sha.description: Full 40-hex source commit SHA the evidence was produced from. MUST equal the candidate source SHA; a mismatch blocks (sha_mismatch). A later commit invalidates this evidence.

merge_group_sha.description: Full 40-hex SHA of the actual merge-group commit, when the run executed in a merge group. Null only for pre-merge lanes; merge authorization requires it.

artifact_digest.description: Immutable digest of the built artifact under test. Release and promotion decisions require it and it MUST equal the certified digest; rebuilding the artifact invalidates digest-bound certification.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the workflow run that produced this record; binds the claim to a command and run.

environment_id.description: The test environment (from the test strategy's five environments) in which the evidence was produced.

test_suite_version.description: Version of the test suite that produced this record.

dependency_lock_hash.description: Hash of the dependency lock inputs, for reproducibility.

random_seed.description: Seed for any randomized or property-based execution; required for reproducibility whenever randomness is used.

collected_at.description: Timestamp at which the evidence was collected into the certification ledger.

collector.description: Identity (automation or person) that collected the evidence; makes every claim attributable to an owner.

content_hash.description: Hash of the evidence content; supports immutability and tamper detection.

expires_at.description: Expiry of this evidence. During certification, evidence MUST be no more than 24 hours old; expired evidence blocks (expired_evidence).

conclusion.description: Authoritative conclusion. BLOCKING SEMANTICS: only 'pass' satisfies a control. 'fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'missing', 'stale', and 'inconclusive' always block. 'not_applicable' satisfies a control only when justified under the register's not_applicable_policy (version-controlled rule, emitted reason, aggregate verification; never contributor-selected).

rule_ref.description: Reference to the version-controlled applicability rule that was evaluated.

evaluated_by.description: The rule evaluation mechanism (never a contributor's manual choice).

not_applicable_justification.description: Required if and only if conclusion is 'not_applicable'.

expected_test_count.description: Number of tests the suite was expected to collect. Zero-test rule: no critical suite may pass with zero tests collected.

failed.description: Any nonzero value with conclusion 'pass' is invalid (see zeroFailuresPass rule).

skipped.description: Unregistered skips in required suites are prohibited by the test strategy.

artifact_reference.description: Resolvable reference to a retained artifact (JUnit results, coverage/mutation reports, SARIF, Schemathesis reproduction cases, Playwright reports/traces, ZAP reports, k6 metrics, rendered manifests, migration/restore reports, SBOMs, signatures, chaos results, trace/alert verification, test-data version).

content_hash.description: Hash of the referenced artifact content.

artifacts.description: Retained artifact list supporting this record. At least one artifact is required.

then.description: not_applicable requires a version-controlled rule justification; a contributor cannot manually select it.
A passing run MUST have zero failures and MUST have executed at least one test (zero-test rule).
